title: LongMindMemEval: MindMate memory storage case study
dataset: 10 synthetic Korean sessions, 206 turns, 9560 o200k_base role:text tokens

initial_state.note: Do not import present production memory pack or persona; prevents future information leakage.

reader.note: fixed reader across all writers; measures memory effect, not Realtime voice end-to-end
reader.pack_section: one shared section; same bound as current default shared section; not full 12000 chars
reader.context: fixed memory pack + unprocessed raw dialogue only; no archived/raw/fact search or fallback
prohibited_fallbacks: whole historical raw injection after consolidation

scoring.primary: strict answer correctness 0/1 and token/USD cost; no additional stored-fact quality benchmark required
scoring.auxiliary: minimal failure notes only, not a second required score
scoring.abstention: correct only where gold unknown; not accepted for an observed date
scoring.clinical_status: past medication and current medication separate items; no medical recommendations
scoring.judge: blind model/condition identifiers; gold evidence and human review of disputed cases; evaluator never treats GPT-5.5 output as gold
scoring.repeat: one run per condition pilot; no significance claim; 3 repeats for finalists in later stage
scoring.aggregation: compare common checkpoints and final panel separately; paired save transitions diagnostic, differing counts not pooled across policies; P1/P5 final panel reuses S10 results
scoring.policy_exclusions: mark each question requiring historical meals as retention-sensitive before run. Report all-answer accuracy and that fixed subgroup separately; never remove failed questions or change gold based on model output. Failure cause policy_excluded only with actual stored-fact/pack trace evidence.

runtime.consolidate: after session ingestion, when period divides session index
runtime.midpoint_probe: at selected user turn, before a later assistant answer or subsequent turn reveals information; isolated runtime snapshot; no consolidation caused by probe
runtime.checkpoint_probe: at every session end: after scheduled consolidation when due, otherwise pack plus pending raw
runtime.final_flush: P3 alone processes residual S10 and answers the same 24 final questions; P1/P5 reuse S10 checkpoint answers without another model call
runtime.evaluation_branch_effects: discard question history, retrieval counters and caches written by evaluation; restore frozen state for each question
runtime.pack_refresh: on session-date/state transition once as needed, freeze per question group; post-write pack built once; no per-question rebuild
runtime.paired_evaluation: before every actual scheduled consolidation, ask the checkpoint questions for that session with old pack plus all pending raw; after consolidation, reuse checkpoint answers on new pack only
runtime.pre_save_pack: freeze the pack actually used for this session before evaluating; do not rebuild or mutate selection counters per question

clock.wall_clock: not used for simulated fact lifecycle
clock.per_session: as_of date at 20:00 Asia/Seoul is execution clock only; not claimed utterance time
clock.sources: event_time from utterance, observed_date from session
clock.requirement: use both python_clock and ClockConnection; isolated schema defaults initialized by prepare_clock_defaults; do not use server wall clock
clock.adapter: eval/longmind_clock.py; single-threaded isolated worker, dedicated lmme_run_ schema, no public fallback
clock.validation: 2026-10-24: 4 offline clock checks and 3 actual PostgreSQL isolated-schema checks passed, including virtual-date UPDATE and pack refresh; tests rolled back
clock.semantic_limit: mocked UPDATE tests validate infrastructure only; whether each writer identifies the date correction is measured by the paid comparison

storage_policy_overrides.sensitive_access: allowed for specified synthetic health story in evaluation only
storage_policy_overrides.past_history: answer-time retrieval disabled; retain DB history but reader sees only pack plus unprocessed raw. Historical facts intentionally excluded by policy are separately diagnosed.
storage_policy_overrides.meal_retention: unchanged production rules: cooking-owned recent_meal fallback 7 days; explicit valid_until honored in shared too; past event/task excluded from prompt; do not force all shared meals to expire
storage_policy_overrides.rules_appendix: 이 실험의 주체는 johangjoo 하나다. 사용자 원문에 근거한 기억만 추출한다. 캐릭터 접근 차이는 평가하지 않으며 scope=shared, owner_character_id=null로 통일한다. 복약 정보는 사용자가 이 실험에서 기억 평가를 요청한 사실이므로 평가 저장소에서만 접근을 허용한다. 사실의 중요도는 기존 1~5 규칙으로 모델이 부여하며 정답표를 보지 않는다. 일시적인 배고픔·졸림·인사는 제외하고 실제로 먹은 식사는 날짜가 있는 사건으로 남긴다. 원문의 session_id, turn_id, role, session_date를 보존해 각 추출 사실에 source_turn_ids를 반환한다. 가정·AI의 제안과 사용자 확정을 구분한다. 대화가 끝날 때까지의 발언만 사용하며 제공되지 않은 미래 사실을 추정하지 않는다. 여러 세션을 함께 처리할 때도 각 발언의 날짜를 기준으로 오늘·어제를 해석한다.

cost.main: sum session-start prompt inputs + storage extraction/update inputs/outputs + embeddings + final flush
cost.excluded: direct dialogue input/output, speech/TTS, failure retries
cost.evaluation_calls: One writer: P1 137, P3 110, P5 100 reader calls; 347 reader and 347 judge calls, plus writer calls and embeddings. Evaluation overhead separate from operating cost.
cost.realtime_start: assembled token counts repriced, estimated unless actual Realtime usage collected
cost.cache: actual cached input subset, plus normalized zero-cache comparison; no assumption of universal hit
cost.reasoning: subset of output, not additional second charge
cost.local: API fee zero, GPU energy estimate and wall time separate; idle/hardware costs excluded from main metric
cost.reader_retrieval: zero: reader retrieval and its embeddings are disabled; writer reconciliation embeddings remain charged
cost.report_totals: operational subtotal, evaluation research overhead, and combined actual API USD; Realtime repricing remains estimated until actually called

reviewer_model_identity: not recorded reliably; do not attribute final adjudication to a named model
code_scope: Archived evidence plus offline validation; no paid API/DB runner included
